g.title: CCA_QSP
g.text: delivered dose as an output · resistance as a pre-existing clone · two competing hazards

g.title: cluster_why
g.text: 0 · Observations the linear cascade cannot survive

g.title: cluster_genome
g.text: 3 · Genomic drivers (actionable ~40% of iCCA, ~10% of eCCA)

g.title: cluster_fgfr
g.text: 5 · FGFR2 signalling and the phosphate axis

g.title: cluster_stroma
g.text: 6 · Desmoplastic stroma · interstitial pressure · drug penetration

g.title: cluster_clone
g.text: 8 · Tumour cell populations — resistance is SELECTED, not induced

g.title: cluster_gate
g.text: 18 · THE DOSE GATE — delivered dose is a model OUTPUT

g.title: cluster_endpoint
g.text: 20 · Clinical endpoints — two competing hazards on different clocks

g.title: cluster_fals
g.text: 21 · Falsifiers — one parameter each, refitted to the same anchor

g.title: OBS_A
g.text: (A) Response and survival are only loosely coupled
ABC-02 gem/cis: ORR ~26%, mPFS 8.0 mo, mOS 11.7 mo
BSC-level tumour kinetics do not explain the death rate

g.title: OBS_B
g.text: (B) The commonest terminal event is biliary, not bulk
cholangitis / obstructive liver failure kills before
tumour volume becomes lethal, especially in pCCA/dCCA

g.title: OBS_C
g.text: yet without it no systemic therapy can be given at dose

g.title: END_HAZB
g.text: cholangitis episodes x obstruction x ALBI

g.title: OBS_D
g.text: (D) FGFR2-fusion tumours nearly always progress on
(V564F, N550K...) detectable in ctDNA before imaging

g.title: GATE_DEL
g.text: an emergent variable — never an input

g.title: OBS_E
g.text: (E) TOPAZ-1: durvalumab moved median OS 11.5 -> 12.8 mo
A mean-effect model cannot separate tails.

g.title: TUM_SEED
g.text: T_R(0) = T_total(0) x mu x g

g.title: OBS_F
g.text: Benefit with almost no shrinkage = cytostatic, not cytotoxic.

g.title: IMM_MIX
g.text: a MIXTURE parameter, not a mean effect:
only a minority of tumours are immunologically hot

g.title: OBS_G
g.text: (G) Anatomic subtype reorders the failure mode:
FGFR2 fusions / IDH1 mutations are essentially confined
to intrahepatic disease; hilar disease fails by obstruction

g.title: DRG_CYTO
g.text: this is the model's stated prediction

g.title: SUB_HILAR
g.text: the single geometric parameter that decides
whether the patient fails by bulk or by obstruction
